description: The Federal Office for the Environment runs the portal Hydrological data and forecasts, which gives current and past data on rivers, lakes and groundwater in Switzerland together with forecasts and flood warnings. Station data cover discharge and water level with comparison to the five flood danger levels, water temperature, oxygen and turbidity, and groundwater level and temperature; the portal adds a flood alert map, a flood outlook and natural hazard, drought and groundwater bulletins. The discharge, water level, temperature and danger-level data are also published on the federal Linked Data Service LINDAS, updated every 10 minutes, and in the free app Meine Pegel. Coverage is the FOEN gauging network across Switzerland. Access is free on the web. Caveats: FOEN accepts no liability for incorrect data, and the terms and conditions page was not read. Simulation uses: flood warning and emergency response, reservoir and supply planning in droughts, and hazard exposure. Related records: Swiss dams under federal supervision (data-switzerland-dams-under-federal-supervision) and SVGW water supply statistics (data-svgw-swiss-water-supply-statistics).
